title: Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE — General Assessment #17

pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

4. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

5. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

9. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.

11. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.

12. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Context Page 15 of 59 1 STRAND 1.0: FOUNDATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Music and Dance in Socio-cultural Context and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody in Major Keys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — The speed of the music

2. C — Red, blue, and yellow

3. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. D — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Context Page 15 of 59 1 STRAND 1.0: FOUNDATION; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music and Dance in Socio-cultural Context; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody in Major Keys; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
